facts_source: https://github.com/JustVugg/colibri README.md + LICENSE (Apache-2.0), read 2026-11-28 via raw.githubusercontent.com

logos.name: Kimi
logos.hex: #000000 (rendered #FFFFFF on navy so it stays visible)

logos_source: npm simple-icons@16.38.0 (https://simpleicons.org), CC0-1.0 icon data; trademarks belong to their owners, used to name the models/platforms, no endorsement implied
logos_build: SVG path -> three.js SVGLoader + ExtrudeGeometry with a small bevel, brand colour (thumbnail/logo3d.html) -> 24-angle sprite strips assets/logos/<slug>_sheet.png (tools/logo3d.cjs); only the front-half frames are shown (spin-in from edge-on)

unbranded.name: Windows tile
unbranded.note: no Simple Icons entry -> unbranded Lucide 'monitor' glyph + the word Windows

unbranded.name: Cover topic icon
unbranded.note: Colibri has no Simple Icons entry -> unbranded 3D processor chip built from primitives (thumbnail/logo3d.html?chip=1 -> thumbnail/logo3d_chip_cut.png), brand colours #1d3f86 / #01ccf7 / #b8f1ff

mascot: client's own AIpreneur 3D mascot (assets/mascot3d, hard-linked from the R37 kit), runtime vendor/mascot3d.js + vendor/mascot_host.js (half-body staging)
screen_recording: none (topic is a GitHub repo, not the client's own account/site; no matching recording in brand/rec)

sfx.name: click, key, ping, pop, sparkle, whoosh
sfx.source: repo vo_safe set (via the R37 kit, hard-linked)

voice: ElevenLabs, voice Dakocan (plgKUYgnlZ1DCNh54DwJ), eleven_v4, one untouched take
illustrative: terminal checks and the browser chat are labelled 'ilustrasi' / 'contoh chat' (invented neutral text); every number on screen (8/16/32 GB, 22 GB, 167 GB, 1,56 TB, 0,93 token/detik, 9,4 detik per token, 744B, 284B, 2,8T, 30B) is from the Colibri README; bars are proportional (download bars on a log scale, labelled)
